Partial Shift involves voluntary or emotion-triggered lupine features—ears, tail, eyes, teeth, claws—while retaining full human cognition and humanoid base form. Hybrid Shift is the species' true form: bipedal digitigrade stance, complete fur matching hair color, peak physical strength and sensory acuity, full intelligence, and functional speech. This form is used for combat, pack business, and formal events. Full Shift is quadrupedal wolf form optimized for hunting, pursuit, travel, and pack combat cognition remains intact but communication becomes non-verbal. Werewolf size exceeds natural wolves and varies by individual and blood classification. Neither Hybrid nor Full Shift is superior; each serves distinct tactical purposes.
